					 Administration 
The Windham Administrative Offices, which include the Town Administrator, Finance Director, and Human Resource/Services Coordinator, serve not only to oversee the day to day operations of the Town, but as a means of linking the residents of Windham with their government. 
					 Assessing 
The Assessing Department is responsible for documenting and listing all taxable real property in Windham, maintaining accurate ownership data, and assisting with taxpayers to participate in the various programs offered. 
					 Community Development 
The Community Development Department staff members assist you with your development, permitting, inspection, health and other related needs. 
					 Emergency Management 
Our mission is to provide the residents and business community of Windham with complete, professional, and competent disaster/emergency management services which protect and preserve our quality of life, property, and the environment in which we live. 
					 Finance 
The Finance Office oversees all accounting, debt and cash management services for the Town of Windham; often in cooperation with the Town Treasurer. 
					 Fire Department 
					 General Services 
The General Services Division encompasses the Highway Department, Transfer Station, and Maintenance areas of the Town. 
					 Highway Department 
Learn about the Highway Department. 
					 Human Services 
The Human Services Division offers confidential aide to residents of Windham in need. 
					 IT / GIS Department 
Read about the IT/GIS Department, view town maps, and access geographic data. 
					 Nesmith Public Library 
The Town has a beautiful library, WiFi, Digital Services, Children's Programs and More! 
					 Windham Police Department 
					 Public Health Division 
The Division of Public Health has a critical role in effective local and regional environmental and public health systems. 
					 Recreation Department 
The Recreation Department, in conjunction with the Recreation Committee, is responsible for planning, organizing, and administering recreation services for the community. 
					 Tax Collector 
Gain an understanding of the responsibilities and duties of the Tax Collector of Windham. 
					 Town Clerk 
Gain an understanding of the work and purpose of the Town Clerk Department of Windham. 
					 Transfer Station 
The Solid Waste Department handles disposal needs for the residents of Windham. 
					 Windham Community Television 
WCTV covers town and school meetings as well as local community events. WCTV also offers a wide variety of locally produced programming, and the opportunity for residents to get involved in television production.
